article.title: -(으)ㄹ까 봐 temor
article.part: Discurso académico y conversación — 학술 담화와 회화
article.chapter: Terminaciones coloquiales y conversación avanzada — 구어 종결형과 고급 회화

claims.summary: The construction -(으)ㄹ까 봐 expresses concern about the possibility of something happening and usually explains a preventive action or reaction motivated by that fear.
The form -(으)ㄹ까 봐 is used with a base predicative and its segment expresses the situation feared or anticipated; the main clause usually describes what is done due to that concern.

The article provides several examples of the usage of -(으)ㄹ까 봐, such as '늦을까 봐 택시를 탔어요' (took a taxi to avoid being late), '비가 올까 봐 우산을 가져왔어요' (brought an umbrella in case it rained), '아이를 깨울까 봐 조용히 문을 닫았어요' (closed the door quietly to avoid waking the child), and '자료를 잃어버릴까 봐 두 곳에 저장해 두었습니다' (saved the data in two places to avoid losing it).
